subject: Cohort pilot — payout schedule, registration proof & SLA
messages:
From: Linda Burke <linda@acmeanalytics.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.com
Cc: contracts@acmeanalytics.com
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:34-07:00
Subject: Proposed cohort pilot + revenue split

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for the call earlier — excited to move forward. We have a small cohort of 25 customers we want to roll through a 90-day pilot starting November. Two quick asks before we finalize the SOW:

- Our finance team needs clarity on partner payouts and timing (we prefer net-of-discounts revenue basis).
- We want a simple registration mechanism so Acme receives partner credit for leads we bring in.

I attached the draft SOW and a short PD that outlines the cohort. Can you confirm what you typically pay for cohort referrals and how proof-of-intro should be submitted? Also share the expected SLA for onboarding support during the pilot.

We can route contract redlines to contracts@acmeanalytics.com.

Appreciate it —
Linda Burke
Head of Partnerships
Acme Analytics

Attachments:
- SOW_Acme_v1.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
To: Linda Burke <linda@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, diego_fernandez@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-02T11:05:12-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed cohort pilot + revenue split

Hi Linda — great to hear. Short answers up front, then a couple of guardrails so legal/accounting have what they need.

Summary proposal:
- Revenue-share: 10% of net revenue attributable to Acme-introduced customers for 12 months per cohort customer, with a tiered uplift to 15% after $200k ARR from the cohort.
- Payout cadence: monthly (invoices from Acme; Redwood pays within 45 days of receiving a verified invoice).
- Proof of intro: lead registration via our partner portal + copy of the intro email thread. Window: registration must be created within 30 days of the first contact with the prospect.
- Clawback: standard 180-day clawback on refunds/credits (we're open to a shorter window but need to align with our subscription refund policy).
- Escrow for initial cohort: we propose holding 10% of first-month payouts in an escrow for 90 days to cover reversal risk for pilot churn.

Operational asks for the SOW:
- Add accounting contact for payments and specify invoice template.
- Define onboarding SLA: Redwood will assign a TAM for onboarding and commit to a 5-business-day response during the pilot window, with weekly status syncs.

I attached a simple commission grid to illustrate the math. Diego / Prioym — can you confirm the payout & invoice flow details below and flag anything regulatory / tax that Acme should expect?

If this looks OK to Acme, I can ask legal to push a clean DocuSign SOW for signature next week.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Partnerships Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments:

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Linda Burke <linda@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: contracts@acmeanalytics.com
Date: 2026-10-12T16:22:03-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed cohort pilot + revenue split

Thanks Chloe — a few operational clarifications from Partner Ops (high level so accounting/legal can easily adopt into the SOW):

1) Payout timing: we typically issue partner payouts monthly but pay vendors within 30-45 days of a validated invoice. For clarity, Redwood will process net payouts within 45 days of receiving a compliant invoice that references the HubSpot deal ID (use https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567).

2) Clawback window: Chloe suggested 180 days; Ops recommends 180 to cover billing reversals. If Acme requests 120 days we need a compensating change (e.g., reduce escrow or add non-refundable onboarding fee).

3) Registration evidence: accepted proof is (a) partner portal registration record AND (b) the initial intro email. We cannot accept a retroactive claim after the customer signs without those two items. Example: see the linked email thread used for the demo-registration (drive link).

4) Taxes & withholding: Acme will be treated as an independent contractor. Redwood will provide a 1099-equivalent summary (or local local-tax docs for non-US entities). Payments are gross; any local withholding is the partner's responsibility unless otherwise required by law.

5) Payments & invoices: Send invoices to accounting@redwoodinference.com. Invoice fields required: Redwood vendor ID, invoice date, invoice number, line items referencing cohort customers, and the HubSpot deal ID.

6) DocuSign / signatures: I'll ask legal to prepare DocuSign with the final SOW once Acme confirms the clawback/payout items.

Operational attachments: commission_grid.xlsx (stub)
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567
Accounting contact: accounting@redwoodinference.com

Diego Fernandez

Redwood Inference

Chloe/Diego — thanks for the clarity. We reviewed with finance and legal. Two quick points and then we can sign: 

- We can accept the 45-day payout cadence but would like the clawback shortened to 120 days if Redwood can remove the 10% escrow hold or reduce escrow to 5% for the pilot. That compromise protects both teams.
- Pilot start: Acme can begin onboarding Nov 1; please confirm the TAM assignment and the onboarding kick-off date/time.

We will sign via DocuSign once small edits on the clawback/escrow are updated. Contracts will send redlines to contracts@acmeanalytics.com if any.

I'll also attach the PO when the SOW is final. Looking forward —

Linda Burke
Head of Partnerships
